Requirements: checkmark: Read the adventurer guide and begin your journey.
Description: Welcome to Adventures of Fairytale! Explore at your own pace, follow connected branches, and collect your rewards. For manually verified feats, click the checkmark after you actually perform them.

Requirements: item: minecraft:oak_log x4
Description: Collect wood and craft your first essentials. The wilderness offers no mercy to an empty-handed traveler.

Requirements: item: minecraft:crafting_table x1
Description: A crafting table turns survival into possibility.

Requirements: item: minecraft:cobblestone x16
Description: Find stone and craft tools sturdy enough to venture underground.

Requirements: item: minecraft:white_bed x1; checkmark: Build a safe, enclosed shelter and sleep through a night.
Description: Create a safe shelter and a place to sleep. Craft a white bed, then confirm your shelter after it is usable.

Requirements: item: minecraft:furnace x1
Description: Use a furnace to cook food and refine ores.

Requirements: item: minecraft:iron_ingot x8
Description: Smelt a few iron ingots. Better equipment, stronger walls, and new crafts await.

Requirements: item: minecraft:shield x1
Description: A shield may save your life when the first monster comes knocking.

Requirements: checkmark: Leave your base on a real expedition and return safely.
Description: Set out beyond your starting base with supplies, a bed, and a way to return.

Requirements: checkmark: Claim your first chapter milestone.
Description: You have proven you can survive. The story branches from here: explore, build, cook, master magic, or forge your destiny.

Requirements: item: minecraft:map x1
Description: Begin charting the lands. Xaero's Minimap and World Map are installed for navigation.

Requirements: checkmark: Craft and use a Nature's Compass to find a biome.
Description: Use Nature's Compass to locate a biome worth exploring.

Requirements: structure: minecraft:village_plains
Description: Discover an inhabited village. ChoiceTheorem's Overhauled Village, Better Village, and Towns and Towers add variety to the settlements you find.

Requirements: item: minecraft:emerald x4; checkmark: Make a successful trade with a villager or wandering trader.
Description: Trade with villagers, meet merchants, or work with a village guardian.

Requirements: checkmark: Activate and use at least one Waystone.
Description: Find or craft a Waystone, activate it, and use it to travel between places.

Requirements: checkmark: Craft and equip a Sophisticated Backpack.
Description: Build a Sophisticated Backpack and stock it for a journey.

Requirements: structure: minecraft:shipwreck; item: minecraft:heart_of_the_sea x1
Description: Search an ocean ruin or shipwreck, and bring back something valuable.

Requirements: checkmark: Clear or thoroughly explore one large modded structure.
Description: Explore a significant structure from When Dungeons Arise, Structory, Moog's structures, or another installed structure mod.

Requirements: checkmark: Visit at least three distinct biomes and mark a favorite location on your map.
Description: Discover three notably different biomes, including one from Biomes O' Plenty or Oh The Biomes We've Gone if you can.

Requirements: checkmark: Mark three useful locations on Xaero's World Map and establish a working travel route.
Description: Connect two or more places using Waystones and your atlas. Your world should start feeling like a kingdom.

Requirements: item: minecraft:wheat_seeds x8; item: minecraft:wooden_hoe x1
Description: Set aside land and begin a basic crop farm. Seasons can change how you plan harvests.

Requirements: item: minecraft:wheat x24
Description: Grow and gather a useful wheat harvest.

Requirements: checkmark: Create a working pen and successfully breed at least one pair of farm animals.
Description: Raise or breed livestock so your base has renewable food.

Requirements: item: minecraft:fishing_rod x1; item: minecraft:cod x4
Description: Aquaculture 2 fills rivers and oceans with more fishing possibilities.

Requirements: item: farmersdelight:cutting_board x1
Description: Farmer's Delight gives a kitchen new possibilities.

Requirements: item: farmersdelight:cooking_pot x1; checkmark: Cook at least one completed meal using the Cooking Pot.
Description: Make a Cooking Pot and prepare a hearty meal using Farmer's Delight recipes.

Requirements: checkmark: Prepare and eat a seafood dish using an installed cooking addon.
Description: Use Ocean's Delight, Aquaculture Delight, or vanilla fishing to create a seafood meal.

Requirements: checkmark: Prepare three different crafted meals, not just basic cooked meat.
Description: Cook across different food mods: Delightful, Nether's Delight, Ender's Delight, Twilight's Flavor & Delight, and more.

Requirements: checkmark: Create a furnished dining area and display at least three prepared dishes.
Description: Build a dining space and share a feast. In multiplayer, invite another adventurer; in single-player, set a banquet table.

Requirements: item: minecraft:stone_bricks x32; checkmark: Mark a permanent building site.
Description: Choose a permanent home site and establish the foundations of your future settlement.

Requirements: item: minecraft:lantern x4; checkmark: Add a decorative lighting feature at your base.
Description: Light up your base with lanterns or Fairy Lights decorations.

Requirements: checkmark: Construct a workshop using at least two decorative block types from installed building mods.
Description: Use Chipped, Macaw's building mods, or Chisels & Bits to add meaningful detail.

Requirements: item: minecraft:chest x4; checkmark: Create an organized labeled storage area.
Description: Build useful storage. Sophisticated Storage and Sophisticated Backpacks are available for upgrades.

Requirements: item: minecraft:bookshelf x6; item: minecraft:lectern x1
Description: Build a small library or enchanted study for the magicians in your realm.

Requirements: item: minecraft:white_banner x1; checkmark: Display a custom banner or family standard on your main build.
Description: Design a crest and fly it above your hold.

Requirements: checkmark: Landscape a garden containing at least five different plants or decorative natural blocks.
Description: Create a garden inspired by Serene Seasons, Oh The Trees You'll Grow, Biomes O' Plenty, and other nature mods.

Requirements: checkmark: Finish a recognisable great hall with seating, lighting, and a banner.
Description: Construct and furnish the main communal hall of your home.

Requirements: checkmark: Build a defensible outer wall, watchtower, or castle gate.
Description: Your settlement should be worth defending. Add walls, towers, or a gated entrance.

Requirements: item: minecraft:anvil x1; item: minecraft:grindstone x1
Description: Set up an anvil and a grindstone. Easy Anvils and Easy Magic help streamline your work.

Requirements: checkmark: Open a Tinkers' Construct guide and read about basic tool crafting.
Description: Find or craft a Tinkers' Construct guide, then plan a tool that suits your playstyle.

Requirements: checkmark: Prepare at least sixteen seared-brick materials or the equivalent for a melter.
Description: Use Tinkers' Construct to prepare the bricks needed for a melter or smeltery.

Requirements: checkmark: Assemble a working Tinkers' Construct melter and melt one material.
Description: Build and operate a Tinkers' Construct melter.

Requirements: checkmark: Make at least one successful casting using Tinkers' Construct.
Description: Practice pouring molten materials into a casting table or basin.

Requirements: checkmark: Build a functional multi-block Tinkers' smeltery and smelt a batch of ore.
Description: Construct a full working smeltery and use it to refine metal.

Requirements: item: minecraft:enchanting_table x1
Description: Prepare the enchanting station that will carry your gear into dangerous ruins.

Requirements: checkmark: Use one Apotheosis equipment improvement or salvaging mechanic.
Description: Try Apotheosis affixes, salvaging, or reforging to improve equipment beyond ordinary vanilla gear.

Requirements: checkmark: Create a high-quality upgraded weapon or tool using Tinkers, Apotheosis, or enchanting.
Description: Finish a specially improved weapon or tool: Tinkers' tool, reforged equipment, or enchanted masterpiece.

Requirements: item: minecraft:netherite_ingot x1
Description: An upgrade that withstands the deepest fires.

Requirements: item: minecraft:iron_helmet x1; item: minecraft:iron_chestplate x1; item: minecraft:iron_leggings x1; item: minecraft:iron_boots x1
Description: Begin as a proper knight with complete iron protection.

Requirements: checkmark: Craft and equip a weapon or armor piece from Epic Knights, Immersive Armors, or Spartan Weaponry.
Description: Epic Knights, Immersive Armors and Spartan Weaponry add new equipment types.

Requirements: item: minecraft:bow x1; item: minecraft:arrow x32
Description: Carry a ranged option and stockpile ammunition.

Requirements: checkmark: Recruit or equip a Guard Villager, or build a staffed-looking guard post.
Description: Help protect a village using Guard Villagers or your own defenses.

Requirements: item: minecraft:diamond_sword x1; item: minecraft:diamond_chestplate x1
Description: Forge a diamond-grade sword before challenging stronger threats.

Requirements: kill: minecraft:zombie x10; kill: minecraft:skeleton x5
Description: Test your melee technique against ordinary hostile creatures.

Requirements: checkmark: Find and use one accessory or relic from Artifacts or Relics.
Description: Discover and equip something unusual from Artifacts, Relics, or Curios-compatible items.

Requirements: checkmark: Win a difficult battle wearing your chosen modded armor or wielding a custom weapon.
Description: Earn your title with a worthy battle and equipment that you improved yourself.

Requirements: checkmark: Defend a village raid or protect your settlement from a comparable hostile event.
Description: Secure your settlement against a raid or another major hostile incursion.

Requirements: checkmark: Obtain your first Iron's Spells spell scroll or spellbook.
Description: Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks offers spells, scrolls, crafting stations, and mage equipment.

Requirements: checkmark: Successfully cast a spell from Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks.
Description: Equip a spellbook, learn a spell and cast it safely.

Requirements: checkmark: Build a spellcraft workstation or inscription setup used by Iron's Spells.
Description: Construct a dedicated spellcraft workspace using your modded stations.

Requirements: checkmark: Use at least one offensive and one utility or defensive spell.
Description: Test different magical styles instead of relying on one spell.

Requirements: checkmark: Craft one magical component or item from Forbidden & Arcanus.
Description: Forbidden & Arcanus adds magical materials and powerful crafting systems.

Requirements: item: minecraft:brewing_stand x1; item: minecraft:glass_bottle x3
Description: Build a brewing stand and experiment with potions.

Requirements: checkmark: Learn or cast one spell introduced by Ice and Fire: Spellbooks.
Description: Ice and Fire: Spellbooks introduces magic inspired by dragons and other creatures.

Requirements: checkmark: Defeat a dangerous enemy using both a weapon and a spell during the fight.
Description: Combine steel and spellcraft to make a versatile adventurer.

Requirements: checkmark: Acquire a higher-rarity spell and upgrade your magical equipment.
Description: A veteran mage collects rare magic and prepares for impossible battles.

Requirements: checkmark: Create a furnished magical study with a spellbook, enchanting station, and magical displays.
Description: Complete a magical chamber or shrine at your base.

Requirements: checkmark: Find and observe three different non-vanilla creatures.
Description: Alex's Mobs, Naturalist, and Realm RPG introduce many creatures. Begin keeping field notes.

Requirements: item: minecraft:tropical_fish x1; checkmark: Observe one non-vanilla aquatic mob from Alex's Mobs or Realm RPG.
Description: Seek unusual creatures in oceans, rivers, and coral reefs.

Requirements: checkmark: Tame, breed, rescue, or peacefully interact with a modded animal.
Description: Some creatures are best approached with care rather than a blade.

Requirements: checkmark: Encounter a rare creature from Alex's Mobs, Naturalist, or Realm RPG and bring home evidence.
Description: Find an unusual mob or relic that makes this world different from vanilla Minecraft.

Requirements: kill: minecraft:spider x8; checkmark: Defeat one special hostile mob from Born in Chaos or a comparable combat mod.
Description: Born in Chaos, Majrusz's difficulty and Soulslike Weaponry bring dangerous foes.

Requirements: checkmark: Display three distinct monster trophies, banners, or item frames representing defeated threats.
Description: Build a trophy hall for your discoveries and hard-won victories.

Requirements: checkmark: Document five unique non-vanilla creatures you have encountered.
Description: Record beasts that roam land, air, sea and caves.

Requirements: checkmark: Complete a bounty involving a hostile creature.
Description: Seek a dangerous bounty using Bountiful or ExtraBounties.

Requirements: item: minecraft:raw_iron x16
Description: Find iron and other treasures in a deep cave. Alex's Caves and worldgen mods make caving an adventure.

Requirements: item: minecraft:diamond x4
Description: Bring back rare diamonds before searching truly dangerous depths.

Requirements: item: minecraft:cobbled_deepslate x24
Description: Enter the deepslate layer and return with hard proof.

Requirements: item: minecraft:amethyst_shard x8
Description: Find an amethyst geode and collect its crystals.

Requirements: structure: minecraft:ancient_city
Description: Locate an Ancient City, where noise is the greatest danger.

Requirements: item: minecraft:sculk x8; item: minecraft:echo_shard x2
Description: Collect sculk and echo shards from the deepest dark.

Requirements: checkmark: Visit an Alex's Caves biome and retrieve a unique resource or artifact from it.
Description: Explore at least one specialized cave biome or dimension added by Alex's Caves.

Requirements: checkmark: Enter the Otherside dimension from Deeper and Darker and return alive.
Description: Deeper and Darker opens a frightening realm below the familiar world.

Requirements: checkmark: Return from a major deep-world expedition carrying rare loot.
Description: Prove that no darkness can keep you from the surface.

Requirements: checkmark: Build and enter the Twilight Forest portal.
Description: Create the Twilight Forest portal using the mod's required materials, then step through.

Requirements: checkmark: Explore the Twilight Forest and locate your first boss landmark.
Description: Explore the forest, seek unusual landmarks, and prepare for the succession of bosses.

Requirements: kill: twilightforest:naga x1
Description: Defeat the Naga in its ruined courtyard.

Requirements: kill: twilightforest:lich x1
Description: Climb a Lich Tower and defeat its ruler.

Requirements: kill: twilightforest:minoshroom x1
Description: Search the Minotaur Labyrinth and defeat its dangerous master.

Requirements: kill: twilightforest:hydra x1
Description: Defeat the mighty Hydra after preparing for a fight of fire and fury.

Requirements: checkmark: Defeat the Knight Phantom encounter in the Twilight Forest.
Description: Seek the underground stronghold and defeat its spectral knights.

Requirements: kill: twilightforest:ur_ghast x1
Description: Scale the dark tower and bring down the Ur-Ghast.

Requirements: kill: twilightforest:snow_queen x1
Description: Fight your way through the Aurora Palace and face the Snow Queen.

Requirements: checkmark: Keep trophies or treasures from at least three Twilight Forest bosses.
Description: Complete the major Twilight Forest boss progression and return with your trophies.

Requirements: checkmark: Find an Ice and Fire dragon roost, cave, or visible dragon without needing to fight it.
Description: Ice and Fire brings fearsome dragons and other mythic beasts to the world.

Requirements: item: minecraft:bow x1; item: minecraft:golden_apple x2
Description: Prepare fire resistance, ranged weapons, and strong armor.

Requirements: checkmark: Obtain dragon bone, scales, or an Ice and Fire dragon-related rare material.
Description: Acquire dragon remains or scales from Ice and Fire. Use the checkmark because drop IDs vary between builds.

Requirements: checkmark: Personally defeat one Ice and Fire fire dragon.
Description: Defeat an Ice and Fire fire dragon and claim your prize.

Requirements: checkmark: Personally defeat one Ice and Fire ice dragon.
Description: Face an Ice and Fire ice dragon.

Requirements: checkmark: Find and defeat an Ice and Fire lightning dragon.
Description: Challenge a lightning dragon if your version and worldgen offer one.

Requirements: checkmark: Craft and equip a piece of dragon-themed equipment from Ice and Fire or its Epic Knights/Spartan addons.
Description: Make practical use of your dragon victory in a new weapon or suit of armor.

Requirements: checkmark: Obtain and successfully hatch a dragon egg, if available in this pack.
Description: Attempt to obtain and hatch a dragon egg if enabled by the Ice and Fire configuration.

Requirements: checkmark: Display at least one significant dragon trophy, egg, skull, or dragon-crafted equipment piece.
Description: Prove yourself a dragon slayer and return to the realm with a legendary trophy.

Requirements: checkmark: Build a decorative dragon memorial or treasury at your base.
Description: Create a shrine or hall dedicated to the dragons you encountered.

Requirements: item: minecraft:obsidian x10
Description: Gather obsidian to open a path to the Nether.

Requirements: dimension: minecraft:the_nether
Description: Enter the Nether and establish a safe return point.

Requirements: structure: minecraft:fortress
Description: Locate a Nether Fortress to learn its dangers.

Requirements: kill: minecraft:blaze x5; item: minecraft:blaze_rod x4
Description: Bring down blazes and collect the rods used for magic and brewing.

Requirements: structure: minecraft:bastion_remnant
Description: Explore a Bastion Remnant and bring home an artifact.

Requirements: item: minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull x3
Description: Hunt Wither Skeletons and recover skulls for a dreadful summoning.

Requirements: kill: minecraft:wither x1
Description: Summon and defeat the Wither.

Requirements: item: minecraft:nether_star x1; checkmark: Return safely to the Overworld after a Nether expedition.
Description: Return from the Nether with proof that you faced its worst dangers.

Requirements: checkmark: Find one Cataclysm boss-related structure or clue.
Description: L_Ender's Cataclysm adds dangerous bosses and structures; learn their locations and mechanics.

Requirements: checkmark: Defeat the Ender Guardian from L_Ender's Cataclysm.
Description: Challenge the Ender Guardian and claim its legacy.

Requirements: checkmark: Defeat the Netherite Monstrosity from Cataclysm.
Description: Face the Netherite Monstrosity in its perilous domain.

Requirements: checkmark: Defeat The Harbinger from Cataclysm.
Description: Challenge a machine built for destruction.

Requirements: checkmark: Defeat the Ancient Remnant from Cataclysm.
Description: A buried sovereign awakens in the sands.

Requirements: checkmark: Defeat The Leviathan from Cataclysm.
Description: Brave deep waters and confront a monstrous leviathan.

Requirements: checkmark: Defeat Ignis from Cataclysm.
Description: Defeat Ignis and bring the infernal legend to a close.

Requirements: checkmark: Craft, equip, or display a powerful piece of Cataclysm boss loot.
Description: Turn your victories into legendary equipment and trophies.

Requirements: checkmark: Display proof of at least three distinct Cataclysm boss victories.
Description: Place at least three Cataclysm trophies or signature drops together.

Requirements: checkmark: Claim the Cataclysm progression milestone after completing the boss branches.
Description: The ancient threats have fallen. The realm can finally breathe.

Requirements: item: minecraft:ender_eye x12
Description: Prepare Eyes of Ender for the path to the End.

Requirements: structure: minecraft:stronghold
Description: Locate and enter a Stronghold.

Requirements: dimension: minecraft:the_end
Description: Enter the End dimension for the first time.

Requirements: checkmark: Destroy at least one End Crystal during an Ender Dragon fight.
Description: Destroy the dragon's healing crystals to open an attack window.

Requirements: kill: minecraft:ender_dragon x1
Description: Defeat Minecraft's Ender Dragon and walk through the exit portal.

Requirements: checkmark: Pass through an End Gateway to the outer islands.
Description: Travel beyond the main island through an End Gateway.

Requirements: structure: minecraft:end_city
Description: Discover an End City.

Requirements: item: minecraft:elytra x1
Description: Bring back Elytra from an End Ship.

Requirements: checkmark: Return to your main settlement carrying Elytra and a dragon trophy.
Description: Cross the void, seize your wings, and return home with your story intact.

Requirements: checkmark: Build a useful Productive Bees setup or visit The Bumblezone dimension.
Description: Productive Bees and The Bumblezone offer an entirely different side of exploration.

Requirements: checkmark: Complete a posted contract or bounty.
Description: Use the Bountiful or ExtraBounties systems to earn something with a clear objective.

Requirements: checkmark: Create a custom visual outfit using one installed cosmetic or transmog mod.
Description: Customize a cosmetic armor outfit using Cosmetic Armor Reworked, Cake's Cosmetics, or Transmog.

Requirements: checkmark: Find a beautiful natural biome and build a small shrine or campsite there.
Description: Choose a peaceful home biome and build a small sanctuary.

Requirements: checkmark: Explore and clear a large multi-room modded dungeon.
Description: Seek a major dungeon from When Dungeons Arise or a similar structure mod.

Requirements: checkmark: Defeat at least one boss from Bosses of Mass Destruction, Bosses'Rise, or Realm RPG.
Description: Test a difficult boss from Bosses of Mass Destruction, Bosses'Rise, or Realm RPG.

Requirements: checkmark: Complete one substantial creative build that tells a story about your world.
Description: Build something lasting: a library, memorial, village road, or scenic overlook.

Requirements: item: minecraft:writable_book x1; checkmark: Record five discoveries or adventures in your in-game journal.
Description: Make an expedition journal and record five memorable discoveries.

Requirements: checkmark: Confirm that your settlement has a main hall, secure storage and farms.
Description: You have given the world a place to call home.

Requirements: checkmark: Confirm your atlas has multiple landmarks, travel routes and adventure notes.
Description: The world now holds more than a single home.

Requirements: checkmark: Confirm that you own an upgraded weapon and have mastered a useful spell.
Description: A worthy hero is ready in steel and spell.

Requirements: checkmark: Finish your bestiary and a dragon trophy display.
Description: The bestiary bears witness to your journeys.

Requirements: checkmark: Confirm the Twilight Forest boss progression was completed.
Description: Close the forest chapter and return with a crown of tales.

Requirements: checkmark: Confirm your Cataclysm trophy collection is complete.
Description: Let the old terrors be remembered in history rather than in fear.

Requirements: item: minecraft:nether_star x1; item: minecraft:elytra x1
Description: Prove that the Nether and End hold no remaining fear.

Requirements: checkmark: Complete the main story, then claim your final triumph.
Dependencies: stead, path, might, beasts, crown, ruins, star
Description: From the first log to the last dragon, your choices made the legend. Congratulations, adventurer.
